description: Elections Commission - Amended Notice for Local Authorities in Polonnaruwa District (Order under Section 38(3) of the L. A. E. O.)
reasoning: This gazette content specifically deals with the postponement of local authority elections in the Polonnaruwa Administrative District. It contains a notice of poll under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance, announces the rescheduling of elections from March 9, 2023 to April 25, 2023, and lists the specific local authorities affected. This falls squarely under Election Gazettes (Type 7) as it concerns electoral processes, election scheduling, and official notifications related to local government elections.
